evidence.method: transform restated from the regular 1-D coordinates; CRS restated from the source
evidence.crs_from: the source COGs (ausantarctic/bedmachine/v4.1/cog/<array>.tif) declare EPSG:3031 (WGS 84 / Antarctic Polar Stereographic), origin -3333250, 3333250, cell 500 m, 13333 x 13333, AREA_OR_POINT=Area (gdal.Open on each COG, GDAL 3.13.3, PROJ 9.9.0, 2026-11-28). py/bedmachine_cog.py writes EPSG:3031 into each COG (outputSRS). The NSIDC-0756 v4.1 netCDF (doi:10.5067/POJQI54A45HX) states a CF polar_stereographic grid mapping (latitude_of_projection_origin -90, standard_parallel -71, straight_vertical_longitude_from_pole 0) with crs_wkt "WGS 84 / Antarctic Polar Stereographic" and geospatial_bounds_crs EPSG:3031; GDAL reads that grid mapping with a warning about its axis unit and does not identify it as EPSG:3031, so the COG script states the code
evidence.note: overview levels (<array>_x<f>, byterefs decision 0006) have no documents of their own: py/assertions.py applies this assertion scaled to each level
